title: Saturn's Rings at Opposition
explanation: The ringed planet shines near its brightest, a favorite to point out to the kids at bedtime.

title: The Eagle Nebula's Pillars of Creation
explanation: Towers of cold gas and dust where new stars are being born.

title: A Full Strawberry Moon over Queens
explanation: June's full moon rises low and golden over the East River.

title: The Andromeda Galaxy
explanation: Our nearest large galactic neighbor, 2.5 million light-years away.

title: The Veil Nebula in Hydrogen and Oxygen
explanation: A delicate web of glowing gas marks the expanding remnant of a supernova in Cygnus.

title: Jupiter and Its Great Red Spot
explanation: The solar system's largest storm, wider than Earth, churns on for centuries.

title: The Orion Nebula
explanation: A vast stellar nursery visible to the naked eye in Orion's sword.

title: Earthrise Revisited
explanation: A modern view of our blue planet rising over the lunar limb.

title: The Whirlpool Galaxy
explanation: A grand spiral and its smaller companion, a classic for first telescopes.

title: A Total Lunar Eclipse
explanation: The Moon glows copper-red as it passes through Earth's shadow.

title: Mars near Opposition
explanation: The red planet blazes high in the night sky, closest to Earth this year.

title: The Pleiades Star Cluster
explanation: Seven sisters wrapped in blue reflection nebulosity.

title: The International Space Station Crosses the Sun
explanation: A silhouette transit captured in a fraction of a second.

title: The Horsehead Nebula
explanation: A dark cloud shaped like a knight's chess piece set against glowing hydrogen.

title: Comet over the Catskills
explanation: A bright comet trails its tail above a winter sky north of the city.

title: The Sombrero Galaxy
explanation: An edge-on spiral wearing a broad brim of dark dust.

title: The Lagoon Nebula
explanation: A glowing cloud of star formation in Sagittarius.

title: Saturn's Moon Enceladus
explanation: Icy geysers erupt from a hidden ocean beneath the frozen surface.

title: The Ring Nebula
explanation: A dying star puffs off a glowing shell of gas in Lyra.

title: Quadrantid Meteors over the Hudson
explanation: A cold-night meteor shower streaks above the river valley.
